bullets.text: MTD Misunderstandings Clarified - Misconceptions about Making Tax Digital for Income Tax can lead to compliance issues and penalties.
Understanding MTD Digital Links - Compliance with MTD requires proper digital linking of accounting data to avoid penalties.
Sage Copilot: AI for Finance - **Sage Copilot** integrates AI securely into finance operations, enhancing efficiency and decision-making.
Free E-book on MTD Transition - A comprehensive guide to transitioning from Self Assessment to MTD for Income Tax is now available.
Mental Health for Accountants - Accountants must manage stress effectively during the MTD rollout to maintain mental well-being.
